entries.af66ffe80b573e74: Its strength lies in an integrated technological base in which it handles in-house everything from precision molds for semiconductor manufacturing through molding equipment to singulation equipment. The molding technology based on the multi-plunger method devised by its founder forms the foundation of its current core business, and it has a strong record of adoption in molding equipment for general-purpose memory. It also features production bases in Japan, Malaysia, China and South Korea, enabling it to manufacture and provide service close to semiconductor manufacturers worldwide.

entries.fa732617798b6a5e: Under its long-term vision, 'ＴＯＷＡ Vision 2032,' with the theme 'Transformation to the Summit of the World,' it sets out as its target image a global leading company that continues to create customer value by proposing packaging processes. Its second medium-term management plan, under the slogan 'New Challenges and Leaps Forward,' has the theme 'Creating human resources who lead the next generation through the TOWA Ism,' and sets a revenue target of ¥71.0 billion for the fiscal year ended March 2028. Its business strategy cites responding to customer needs through process innovation in the semiconductor manufacturing equipment business, aiming to become the global cost leader through DX and AI, and delivering one-of-a-kind products to the world through a global development structure.
